summary.zh: 官方 Python SDK（pip 包 typesafe-sdk，要求 Python ≥ 3.10），提供同步/异步客户端与 Choice/Score/Noul 类型，默认读取 TYPESAFE_API_KEY。
summary.en: Official Python SDK (pip package typesafe-sdk, Python >= 3.10) with sync/async clients and Choice/Score/Noul types; reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY by default.

summary.zh: 官方 TypeScript/JavaScript SDK（npm 包 @typesafe-ai/sdk），答案类型可自动推断，内置重试与错误分类。
summary.en: Official TypeScript/JavaScript SDK (npm package @typesafe-ai/sdk) with inferred answer types, built-in retries and error classes.

summary.zh: 官方 Agent Skill：教 Claude Code、Codex 等编码助手正确调用 System One API 的技能包。
summary.en: Official agent skills teaching coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex how to call the System One API.

summary.zh: 官方适配器：用普通 LLM API 模拟 TypeSafeClient，便于对照测试或降级运行。
summary.en: Official adapter that emulates TypeSafeClient on top of ordinary LLM APIs for A/B testing or fallback.

summary.zh: Browser Use 出品的极速网页 Agent：Jev 负责选择操作与目标元素，小模型只在需要打字时介入。发布首周星数最高的 Jev 项目。
summary.en: Browser Use's fast web agent: Jev picks each action and target element while a small LLM only types when needed. The most-starred Jev project of launch week.

summary.zh: 基于 Jev 的浏览器自动化实现。
summary.en: Browser automation driven by Jev.

summary.zh: Claude Code 插件：用 Jev 逐条判断历史工具调用的去留，替代摘要式上下文压缩；保留的内容原样保留。社区对该策略存在争议。
summary.en: Claude Code plugin that replaces compaction summaries with Jev decisions on every past tool call; kept content stays verbatim. The approach is debated in the community.

summary.zh: Claude Code 插件：按任务选择最便宜且够用的模型。
summary.en: Claude Code plugin that routes each task to the cheapest sufficient model.

summary.zh: 分阶段代码审查流程与本地面板。
summary.en: A staged code-review workflow with a local dashboard.

summary.zh: MCP 服务器：把校验、筛选、排序等判断暴露为 Agent 可调用的工具。
summary.en: MCP server exposing typed judgments (screening, filtering, ranking) as agent tools.

summary.zh: MCP 连接器：让 Agent 直接调用 Jev。
summary.en: MCP connector giving agents direct access to Jev.

summary.zh: 编码 Agent 的安全闸门：对每次工具调用给出 deny/ask/allow 风险判断，并标记提示注入；支持多种编码助手。
summary.en: A safety gate for coding agents: risk-scores every tool call as deny/ask/allow and flags prompt injection across many coding assistants.

summary.zh: 用 Jev 审查 Agent Skill 与 MCP 代码中的可疑行为（中文说明项目）。
summary.en: Reviews agent skills and MCP code for suspicious behavior using Jev (Chinese-language project).

summary.zh: 受 Jev 启发的开源实现：在开源模型上复刻“语义 if”接口，3090 显卡可本地运行。原名 OpenJev，作者声明与 TypeSafe 无关；不是 Jev 权重开源。
summary.en: An inspired open-source reimplementation of the 'semantic if' interface on open models, runnable on a single RTX 3090. Formerly OpenJev; the author states it is independent of TypeSafe. Not the Jev weights.

summary.zh: 基于 Qwen3.5 的迷你 Jev 式决策模型，可自行训练并在本机运行。
summary.en: A tiny Jev-like decision-model family built on Qwen3.5 that you can train and run yourself.

summary.zh: 0.6B 参数的 Jev 复刻：并行决策、动态候选与端到端训练流程。社区项目，与官方无关。
summary.en: A 0.6B-parameter Jev replica with parallel decisions, dynamic candidates, and an end-to-end training pipeline. Community project, unrelated to TypeSafe.

summary.zh: PostgreSQL 扩展：用自然语言对表格行做判断。许可证未被 GitHub 识别为标准开源协议。
summary.en: A PostgreSQL extension for asking plain-language questions over table rows. Its license is not recognized by GitHub as a standard open-source license.

summary.zh: LlamaIndex 出品：用 Jev 做快速文档分类与子文档边界识别。
summary.en: From LlamaIndex: fast document classification and sub-document boundary detection with Jev.

summary.zh: Hono 中间件：按语义把请求路由到不同处理器。
summary.en: Hono middleware that routes HTTP requests by meaning.

summary.zh: 用 Jev 选择数据源、理解查询并按相关性排序的网页搜索（基于 Search1API）。
summary.en: Web search where Jev picks sources, interprets queries, and ranks relevance (built on Search1API).

summary.zh: 用人工反馈与 GEPA 校准 Jev 判断函数。
summary.en: Calibrates Jev judgment functions from human feedback using GEPA.

summary.zh: 在 Monad 链上每个区块做一次买卖判断（默认 dry-run 模拟）。仅供研究，不构成任何投资建议；实盘风险自担。
summary.en: Makes one buy/sell decision per Monad block (dry-run by default). Research only — not investment advice; live trading carries real risk.

summary.zh: 英文精选清单，按 13 类收录数百个项目与讨论；作者提醒同日批量提交的项目未经验证。
summary.en: A curated English list of hundreds of projects and discussions across 13 categories; the author warns that same-day batch submissions are unvetted.

summary.zh: 中文精选列表：官方资料、应用、Agent 工具与开源复现，附中文上手指南。
summary.en: A Chinese curated list of official resources, apps, agent tooling, and replicas, with a Chinese quick-start guide.

summary.zh: 用 Jev 筛选历史 Hacker News 评论中的可核验预测；仓库包含预注册试验、实际调用代码和作者发布的结果数据，尚未处理完整档案。
summary.en: Screens historical Hacker News comments for checkable predictions with Jev; includes a preregistered pilot, calling code and author-published results, but not a completed full-archive run.

summary.zh: Rust 代码审查工具：解析源码后向 Jev 提交局部、类型化的维护性判断，并由代码汇成带位置和建议的发现；安全规则需另行启用。
summary.en: Rust code-review tool that asks Jev typed questions about parsed source units, then composes located findings and suggested actions; security rules are opt-in.

summary.zh: pi 的浏览器与 macOS 桌面 Agent 扩展：Jev 根据可见文本、控件和目标选择单步动作，执行循环设有步数和人工复核边界。
summary.en: A pi browser and macOS desktop agent extension: Jev chooses one action from visible text, controls and the goal, within a bounded loop with human-review gates.

summary.zh: 用 Jev 的 Noul、Choice、Score 比对基准合同与扫描件 OCR 文本，区分实质变化和识别噪声，并把低于作者阈值的结果交给人工复审；含真实 API 调用与一致性测试。
summary.en: Compares a baseline contract with scanned-copy OCR text using Jev Noul, Choice and Score questions, separates substantive changes from recognition noise and sends results below the author's cutoff to human review; includes a real API call and consistency tests.

summary.zh: Jev 决策的对抗评估资料库：提供 typed questions、单处改动样本、直接调用 TypeSafe API 的脚本和作者结果；代码与数据许可证不同，鲁棒性指标未由本站复算。
summary.en: An adversarial Jev decision benchmark with typed questions, single-edit variants, a direct TypeSafe API evaluator and author-published results. Code and data have different licenses; robustness figures were not independently reproduced.

summary.zh: 为编码 Agent 检索仓库上下文的 CLI：用 Jev 判断目录、文件与代码单元的任务相关性，输出带行号的原文片段；待评估源码可能发往外部服务。
summary.en: A coding-agent CLI that uses Jev to judge the relevance of folders, files and source units, then returns line-referenced excerpts; eligible source content may be sent to an external provider.

summary.zh: Jev 请求预检查工具：离线规则筛结构缺陷，再以 Jev Noul 判断语义问题，给开发者警告与修改建议；语义层需要外部 API。
summary.en: Lints Jev requests with offline structural rules and Jev Noul judgments for semantic defects, then reports suggested fixes; the semantic layer needs an external API.

summary.zh: 编码 Agent 的浏览器 MCP/CLI：Jev 每步选择动作与元素，客户端校验返回后驱动 Chrome；仓库的速度基准只代表作者测试环境。
summary.en: A browser MCP server and CLI for coding agents: Jev selects an action and element each step, and the client validates the reply before driving Chrome. Speed benchmarks are author-reported.

summary.zh: 用 Jev 的 Noul 为社区消息输出多种风险类别概率，供 Bot、CLI、API、MCP 共用策略；默认只标记，模型故障时放行并记录错误。
summary.en: Uses Jev Noul questions to score community-message risks across bots, CLI, API and MCP interfaces; defaults to flag-only and leaves messages alone on model failure.

summary.zh: 连接 TypeSafe System One 的 MCP 工具、可嵌入 DecisionModel 和编码助手插件；源码提供请求校验与预算控制，插件提示不替代宿主权限。
summary.en: MCP tools, an embeddable DecisionModel and a coding-agent plugin for TypeSafe System One, with request validation and budget controls; plugin advice does not replace host permissions.

summary.zh: 用 Jev Choice 从合法动作中选择安卓设备下一步，配合 SQLite 任务状态、执行前记录及执行后观察验证；需要 USB 调试和外部 API。
summary.en: Uses Jev Choice to select the next valid Android action, with SQLite task state, a mutation journal and post-action observation; requires USB debugging and an external API.

summary.zh: 把 Jev 从单个封闭判断逐级接入 Agent hooks 的教学代码库，含 TypeSafe/OpenRouter 真调用、离线 mock、交互演示与测试；速度和成本数字为作者材料。
summary.en: A progressive code lab from one bounded Jev decision to agent hooks, with live TypeSafe/OpenRouter calls, an offline mock, demos and tests; speed and cost figures are author-reported.

summary.zh: macOS 电脑操作 Beta：以 Jev Choice 从屏幕状态选动作与控件，代码执行并复核下一帧；操作真实鼠标键盘，应先 dry-run。
summary.en: A macOS computer-use beta that asks Jev Choice to select actions and controls from screen state, then executes and checks the next frame; it drives real input, so start with a dry run.

summary.zh: 软件工厂监工：Jev 持续评估 Codex/OpenCode 工人的完成度、需求满足与测试充分性，代码决定继续、纠偏或停止。
summary.en: A software-factory foreman: Jev continuously scores Codex/OpenCode workers on completeness, requirements, and test sufficiency while code decides to continue, steer, or stop.

summary.zh: 原版 Minecraft 通关 Agent：GPT-6 Astra 规划、Jev 逐动作选择，最佳全程 8 分 43 秒、131 次 Jev 决策，不修改游戏规则。
summary.en: A vanilla-Minecraft speedrun agent where GPT-6 Astra plans and Jev picks each action; best verified run 8m43s with 131 Jev decisions and no rule changes.

summary.zh: NES 超级马里奥实验控制器：模拟器状态转结构化 JSON（无截图），Jev Choice 从 7 个合法手柄动作中选择；仓库不含 ROM。
summary.en: An experimental NES Super Mario controller that feeds structured JSON state (no screenshots) to a Jev Choice over seven legal inputs; ships no ROM.

summary.zh: droidrun 出品的安卓 Agent：Jev 经 Mobilerun API 操作真机，附 React Studio、CLI 与请求级延迟记录；Uber 演示 9 步约 21 秒停在支付页。
summary.en: droidrun's Android agent where Jev drives a real phone via the Mobilerun API, with a React studio, CLI, and per-request latency traces; the Uber demo does 9 actions in ~21 s and stops at payment.

summary.zh: 语音控制真实浏览器：流式部分转写触发一次 Jev 请求（9-11 问），约 300ms 决定执行/等待/询问/忽略；文本只由代码提取、Jev 挑选。
summary.en: Voice control for a real browser: each partial transcript fires one 9-11 question Jev request (~300 ms) to act, wait, ask, or ignore; text is extracted by code and only picked by Jev.

summary.zh: MuJoCo 四旋翼仅凭机载相机过五站障碍课程：Jev 以 2.5Hz 做战术判断，50Hz 安全反射与 500Hz 控制器保留否决权。
summary.en: A MuJoCo quadrotor flies a five-station course from its onboard camera alone; Jev judges tactics at 2.5 Hz while 50 Hz reflexes and a 500 Hz controller keep the veto.

summary.zh: Codex 逐调用模型路由：Jev 同时选模型与推理强度（含工具后续轮），Jev 只见有界决策状态，出错 fail-open。
summary.en: Per-call model routing for Codex: Jev picks model and thinking effort together (continuations included) from a bounded decision state, failing open on any error.

summary.zh: Claude Code 插件：命令跑完后、结果回传主模型前，用 Jev 逐块判断 Bash 输出是否需要保留；文档、错误与 git diff 豁免。
summary.en: A Claude Code plugin that prunes noisy Bash output after the command runs but before the LLM sees it, one Jev noul per chunk, with documents, errors, and git diff exempt.

summary.zh: Neo4j 图导航演示：每跳用 Choice 选出边、Noul 判目标，同请求一次往返，再对概率做束搜索渲染路径；schema 动态自省。
summary.en: A Neo4j navigation demo where each hop asks one Choice over outgoing edges plus a goal noul in a single round trip, then beam-searches the probabilities; schema is introspected live.

summary.zh: Pi 编码 agent 的决策层：闸门一次请求判破坏性/外传/超范围/影响，输出裁判查泄密；默认 shadow 提示，错误一律 fail-open。
summary.en: A decision layer for the Pi coding agent: one gated request judges destructiveness, exfiltration, scope, and impact, plus an output judge for secrets; shadow mode by default and every error fails open.

summary.zh: 视频真话仪表盘：按预设逐句给视频打分、标记回避与炒作，渲染 16:9 成片；整场辩论约 0.05 美元。
summary.en: A live meter for videos: every sentence scored against a preset, dodges and hype flagged, rendered as a postable 16:9 edit; a full debate costs about $0.05.

summary.zh: zsh 的 fish 式历史建议：Jev Choice 从最近 100 条去重历史里判断你在补全哪条，灰显在光标后并附概率。
summary.en: Fish-style zsh autosuggestions where a Jev Choice ranks which of your last 100 distinct commands you are completing, shown in grey with its probability.

summary.zh: 没有语言模型写一字的聊天命令条：Jev 选工具、参数来源与是否确认，代码调 MCP 并用工具数据拼回复，页面值皆有出处。
summary.en: A chat command bar where no LLM writes a word: Jev picks the tool, argument sources, and confirmations while code calls MCP servers and builds replies from tool data.

summary.zh: 趣味 Chrome 扩展：代码预筛广告形 DOM 候选，Jev 每候选一个 Noul 判“是否广告”，P≥0.70 移除；作者明示非真广告拦截。
summary.en: A fun Chrome extension where code pre-filters ad-shaped DOM candidates and one Jev noul per candidate decides "is this an ad?"; elements above 0.70 are removed. The author calls it a toy, not uBlock.

summary.zh: 开源 Gmail 分诊：每封 3 问分五个托盘并打紧急度，只读不代发；1000 封约 1 分钟约 3 美分，纠错与概率本地留痕。
summary.en: Open-source Gmail triage: three questions per message sort five trays with urgency, strictly read-only; 1,000 emails in about a minute for a few cents, with corrections stored locally.

summary.zh: Home Assistant 集成：Noul/Choice/Score 问答变成传感器实体与自动化动作，附 25 个蓝图、Assist 语音路由与每日花费统计；与 TypeSafe 无关的社区作品。
summary.en: A Home Assistant integration that turns Noul/Choice/Score questions into sensor entities and automation actions, with 25 blueprints, Assist routing, and daily cost reporting; community-made, unaffiliated with TypeSafe.

summary.zh: 一个会变形的输入框：一次 Jev 调用 14 问判断输入应变成日程卡/清单/分账/取色等哪种 UI，日期金额由确定性代码计算，默认离线兜底。
summary.en: An input that becomes what you mean: one 14-question Jev call morphs the box into an event card, checklist, bill splitter, or color picker, while dates and math stay deterministic with an offline fallback.

summary.zh: 把 agent 评估与护栏做成 Jev 决策：一条 trace 一次请求并行 8 项判定，千分之几美分、数百毫秒，可跑全量流量；后端可选 TypeSafe/Vercel、本地 Kev/Laya 或普通 LLM。
summary.en: Evals and guardrails as Jev decisions: eight parallel judgments per trace in one request at a few thousandths of a cent, fast enough for every trace; backends span TypeSafe/Vercel, local Kev/Laya, or a plain LLM.

summary.zh: Claude Code 的校准上下文筛：每个大工具结果分块过一个 Noul“任务是否需要”，高置信不需要的替换为存根+摘要+召回键，不确定的保留。
summary.en: A calibrated context sieve for Claude Code: every large tool result is split and judged block-by-block; confident-no blocks become stub-plus-summary with a recall key, while uncertain ones stay.

summary.zh: 手机对话副驾（安卓主仓 + Windows/macOS 姊妹仓）：读屏采集对话，Jev 判断意图与情绪并给候选排序，悬浮窗一键填入、发送永远手动；不依赖任何平台接口。
summary.en: A mobile chat copilot (Android hub plus Windows/macOS siblings) that reads the screen, lets Jev judge intent and mood and rank drafts, then fills the input box — sending stays manual, no platform APIs involved.

summary.zh: SemIf 作者的开放模型版：在 3090 或浏览器里跑“语义 if”接口模式。独立项目，与 Jev/TypeSafe 无关，非 Jev 权重开源。
summary.en: The SemIf author's open-models edition of the semantic-if interface, runnable on a 3090 or in the browser. Independent and unaffiliated with Jev or TypeSafe; not Jev weights.

summary.zh: 诺基亚应用研究出品：无需微调把任意 LLM 变成 Jev 式校准决策端点（序翻转率与校准误差显著改善），可经 vLLM 服务化。
summary.en: From Nokia applied research: turn any LLM into a Jev-style calibrated decision endpoint without fine-tuning (measurably better order-flip and calibration error), servable via vLLM.

summary.zh: 开源 System One 决策模型：非自回归、宣称亚 15ms、可本地部署的 Jev 替代。社区实现，与 TypeSafe 无关。
summary.en: An open-source System One decision model: non-autoregressive, sub-15 ms claims, local drop-in alternative. Community work, unaffiliated with TypeSafe.

summary.zh: Featherless 出品：直接读开放模型 logits 做结构化分类/评分，免登录公共 demo（2k 上下文、限速 2 RPS），附评测框架。
summary.en: From Featherless: read open-model logits directly for structured classification and scoring, with a no-login public demo (2k context, 2 RPS) and an eval framework.

summary.zh: 基于 DiffusionGemma 的开源 Jev 兼容决策服务器，本地可跑。社区复刻，与官方无关。
summary.en: An open, Jev-compatible decision server built on DiffusionGemma that runs locally. A community replica, unrelated to TypeSafe.

summary.zh: 把本地语言模型转成 Jev 式结构化决策模型，支持文本与图像输入。独立实现，非 Jev 权重。
summary.en: Turn local language models into Jev-style structured decision models over text and images. Independent implementation, not Jev weights.

summary.zh: 用 SGLang 服务 Qwen3.6-35B 实现 TypeSafe/Jev HTTP API：每容器一张 B200、radix 缓存与可断 prefill CUDA 图，附 Modal 一键部署与冒烟测试。
summary.en: Serves Qwen3.6-35B on SGLang behind the TypeSafe/Jev HTTP API: one B200 per container, radix caching, breakable prefill CUDA graphs, plus Modal deploys and a smoke test.

summary.zh: 基于 GliFormer 的自托管 Jev 替代（LangChain 作者之一出品）：drop-in 兼容，跑在自己的机器上。社区项目，与 TypeSafe 无关。
summary.en: A self-hosted, GliFormer-powered drop-in replacement for Jev by a LangChain author; runs on your own machine. Community project, unaffiliated with TypeSafe.

summary.zh: 独立开源的非自回归 System 1 决策引擎（自有模型，非 Jev 实现、更非 Jev 权重开源）：对任意文本输出 Choice/Score/是否判断，可本地或经兼容接口服务，也出现在 JevBench 等第三方评测里。
summary.en: An independent open-source non-autoregressive System 1 decision engine (its own model — neither a Jev implementation nor Jev weights): typed choice, score, and yes/no decisions over any text, served locally or behind compatible APIs, and measured by third-party boards like JevBench.

summary.zh: 社区维护的核验型目录：收录 944 个 Jev 开源项目并标注证据。
summary.en: A community-maintained, verified catalog of 944 open-source Jev projects with evidence labels.

summary.zh: 面向 Jev 工具的精选清单。
summary.en: A curated list of tools built for Jev.

summary.zh: Jev / TypeSafe System One 应用、库与资源精选（CC0 发布）。
summary.en: A curated list of Jev / TypeSafe System One applications, libraries, and resources, published under CC0.

summary.zh: Jev 用例、工作流与 agent skills 集合。
summary.en: A collection of Jev use cases, workflows, and agent skills.

summary.zh: WXT 浏览器扩展：Jev 判断页面杂项元素并移除，清理规则可存为可复用模板。
summary.en: A WXT browser extension where Jev spots page clutter for removal, with reusable template rules.

summary.zh: 把模型、子代理、Skill、MCP 工具与 CLI 变成一个候选集：Jev 答一道 Choice，路由器负责可用性、权限、风险与确认；默认只决策不执行。
summary.en: Models, subagents, skills, MCP tools, and CLIs become one candidate set: Jev answers a single Choice while the router enforces availability, permissions, risk, and confirmation; decision-only by default.

summary.zh: 本地编码 agent 网关：把“下一步调哪个工具”交给 Jev，其余流量原样走原有 LLM；兼容 Codex/Claude Code/OpenCode/Kilo 与订阅登录。
summary.en: A local gateway for coding agents that hands the "which tool next" decision to Jev while everything else flows to your usual LLM untouched; works with Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Kilo, and subscription logins.

summary.zh: Jev 级决策模型基准（95 个系统在线排行，Jev 1.13 现列第 4）：冻结方法、封存决策与 SHA-256 清单，与 TypeSafe 无关。
summary.en: A benchmark for Jev-class decision models with a live board of 95 systems (Jev 1.13 currently #4): frozen method, sealed decisions, and a SHA-256 manifest; unaffiliated with TypeSafe.

summary.zh: jarvis 内核的 Windows 版：窗口截图 + 本地离线 OCR 读微信/KakaoTalk，Jev 判断意图情绪、给 3 条候选一键填入；发送永远手动。
summary.en: The Windows sibling of the Jev chat copilot: window screenshots plus offline OCR read WeChat or KakaoTalk, Jev judges intent and mood and offers three ranked drafts; sending stays manual.

summary.zh: Ruby 决策模型客户端：一套 Client 走 OpenRouter（默认）或 TypeSafe 直连，Noul/Score 返回校准概率，无运行时依赖。
summary.en: The decision-model client for Ruby: one Client over OpenRouter (default) or direct TypeSafe, returning calibrated noul/score answers with zero runtime dependencies.

summary.zh: CodexQA 技能：以页面内索引代替视觉模型做浏览器自动化，Jev 只从已索引控件中选择，Playwright 执行；回放、目标运行与站点探索共用同一索引。
summary.en: A CodexQA skill that replaces vision GUI models with an in-page index: Jev chooses only among indexed controls while Playwright acts; replay, goal runs, and site exploration share the index.

summary.zh: TypeSafe Jev 的 Python 批处理代理：多个独立状态并发逐条调用官方 API，再按输入顺序输出 Apache Arrow 流；附 Python 与 JavaScript 读取器，非官方原生批量接口。
summary.en: A Python batching proxy for TypeSafe Jev: calls the official API once per independent state concurrently, then streams ordered Apache Arrow results, with Python and JavaScript readers; not a native batch API.

summary.zh: 浏览器业务流程测试：Jev 初次定位页面控件并记录语义路径，后续可无模型回放；代码通过请求、API/数据库断言判定成败。
summary.en: Browser business-flow tests: Jev initially grounds controls and records semantic paths for model-free replay; code decides verdicts from requests and API/database assertions.

summary.zh: 交互式 Jev 决策评测台：实际 TypeSafe 基线与模拟器、独立模型及 judge 逐题比较并保存执行追踪；默认托管模拟器会接收场景文本。
summary.en: An interactive Jev decision playground comparing a real TypeSafe baseline with an emulator, independent model and judge while saving execution traces; its default hosted emulator receives scenario text.

summary.zh: IRS 表单 PDF 文本页分类器：Jev Choice 选表单和页面类别，按置信度门控后续路由；英文联邦表单限定，作者评测数据未由本站复测。
summary.en: An IRS PDF text-page classifier using Jev Choice for form and page kind with a confidence gate for routing; limited to English federal forms and not independently benchmarked here.

summary.zh: TypeSafe 官方 n8n 社区节点：对每个 item 调用 System One 的 Choice、Score、Noul；Evaluate 附加结构化答案，Route 按答案或置信度把 item 分发到预设输出。
summary.en: TypeSafe official n8n community node calls System One Choice, Score, and Noul per item; Evaluate attaches typed answers and Route dispatches items by answer or confidence.

summary.zh: TypeSafe 官方工作流评测代码：复现发票、客服、代理轨迹和安保事件的有界决策评测，将 Jev 与其他提供商按参考模型动作一致性、成本和耗时对照；一致率不等于真实业务正确率。
summary.en: Official workflow evaluation code for invoice, support, agent-trace, and security decisions; compares Jev and other providers on agreement with reference-model actions, cost, and time, which does not establish ground-truth business accuracy.

summary.zh: NetHack 5.0 游戏代理：代码读终端画面并枚举合法动作，Jev Choice 选一步，motor 发送对应按键；仓库有运行记录，未核实通关。
summary.en: A NetHack 5.0 agent where code reads the terminal and enumerates legal actions, Jev Choice picks one, and a motor sends the corresponding keys; runs are documented but ascension is unverified.

summary.zh: 从移动 App 验收目标探索 Appium 操作路径：Jev 从屏幕现有动作中选择，工具生成固定选择器的 WebdriverIO 测试并无模型回放；缺少断言时须人工复核。
summary.en: Explores Appium paths from mobile acceptance goals with Jev choosing on-screen actions, then generates fixed-selector WebdriverIO tests and replays without a model; goals without assertions need review.

summary.zh: Jev 驱动的 RAG 入库与检索管线：段落杂质和指令筛选、片段相关/冲突判断及可回答性门控；支持多种向量库，无 key 时降级为普通检索，评测数字为作者自报。
summary.en: A Jev-driven RAG ingestion and retrieval pipeline with paragraph screening, passage relevance/conflict checks, and an answerability gate; supports several vector stores, degrades without a key, and reports author-measured benchmarks.
